# Disagreement Log — Gospel of Thomas, Saying 40

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** GTH 040
**Total Disagreements:** 2

---

## Disagreement 1 — "has not taken root" vs. "has no strength"

**Verse:** v.1
**LOGOS:** "has not taken root"
**PNEUMA:** "has no strength"
**Issue:** The Coptic *nsekot* means "not established/rooted." "Has not taken root" is the agricultural metaphor. "Has no strength" is a consequence, not the root cause.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "Has not taken root" retained.

---

## Disagreement 2 — "perish" vs. "die"

**Verse:** v.1
**EMET/LOGOS:** "will perish"
**PNEUMA:** "will die"
**Issue:** *Tako* = to perish, be destroyed; more comprehensive than simply dying. "Perish" preserves the eschatological register.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "Perish" retained.

---
